assignment: Draw only at episode start; hold snapshot identity and type until terminal. Alternate learner side. Sampling for both model participants; only learner actions enter PPO loss.
snapshots: Every 60 minutes of PPO; retain all snapshots
smoke: 10 minutes lr=0 after frozen arena desynchronization; all 59 tensors unchanged and outcomes/rewards for every opponent type
warmup: Value only; at least20 and at most60 blocks; EV after0:00 averaged over5 blocks >0.3
evaluation: Every120 minutes PPO, paused training; final against v10/v9/two-hours-earlier/000470; optional 000470-v9 reference if time remains
metrics: death matches and first death time
death cause and distances to both T1
each raze casts and hero hits for both players
hero attack orders and released attacks
event-v2 reward and all six components
curves: per100 completed full-reward matches by opponent type: wins/farm/deaths
publication: Logical commits prefixed[P11]; hourly curves/report, immediately after evaluation; each evidence file<1MB; no weights/datasets/replays/binaries
autonomy: No user questions; decisions and limitations documented. Restart failed training from latest checkpoint; no metric-based early stopping. Simulator only.
